entries.answer:
I reviewed the attached file (`file-1.html`, 4,874 lines) with automated checks (JS syntax via `node --check` on all 6 script blocks, HTML tag-balance and duplicate-ID parsing, CSS brace balancing) plus a line-by-line manual read of the `<head>`, the full CSS block (lines 35–847), script 1 (851–1974, the GlassKit UMD library), and script 2 (1978–2457, the native-bridge module). The verified error list from that reviewed portion is below.[1]

1. [line 53 / `--blue-l`] — Custom property named `--blue-l` (light blue) is assigned `#00ff00` (pure green); name/value mismatch.
2. [line 54 / `--green-soft`] — Custom property named `--green-soft` is assigned `#ffffff` (pure white); all "green" accents that consume it (lines 227, 255, 258, 294, 297, 313, 408, 610, 737) render white.
3. [line 1300 / `parseColor` byte-detection loop] — Redundant condition: `(v === Math.floor(v) && v > 1)` is fully subsumed by the preceding `v > 1`, so the second test is dead code with ambiguous intent.
4. [line 1302 / `parseColor`] — `if (r > 1 || g > 1 || b > 1) isByte = true;` re-detects exactly what the loop at lines 1298–1301 already computed; duplicated logic.
5. [lines 963–995 / `MemoryStorage` + `getLocalStorage`] — In-memory stub standing in for `localStorage` when unavailable; stored data silently evaporates between sessions (stub content).
6. [lines 1019–1055 / `matchMedia` fallback] — Simulated MediaQueryList with hardcoded results: `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` hardcoded to `matches = false` (line 1050), `prefers-color-scheme: dark` hardcoded to `matches = true` (line 1051) (fake/simulated content).
7. [line 2141 / `_flush` → `performance.now()`] — Unguarded `performance.now()` in the payload build (outside the `try` at 2151–2153), while the same file defensively guards `performance` at line 2160; ReferenceError if `performance` is undefined (inconsistent guard).

END OF ERROR LIST

## Coverage status

This is a partial report, and I won't pretend otherwise: roughly 2,400 lines remain unverified — the `<body>` markup (2460–2559), script 3 (2561–3858, including the `/api/chat` fetch at 3648 and the markdown renderer), script 4 (3862–4318, the `$()`-based UI module), script 5 (4323–4819), script 6 (4824–4869), and the tails of the `apple-touch-startup-image` links (lines 22–31), where I could not yet confirm whether the required `href` attributes are present. Verified clean so far: zero JS syntax errors in all six blocks, zero HTML tag mismatches, zero duplicate IDs (39 unique), balanced CSS braces (292/292), and every `getElementById`/`$("…")` reference resolving to a defined or dynamically created element. Tell me to continue and I'll complete the remaining blocks and reissue one consolidated final list.
